remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Whitney Museum, April 1946 [note of inscription 2]. . . . On frame: 'Black Spot #2'" [not verified]. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) and 1934 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 13, 56. Reproduced and titled *Black Spot* in *Dial* (December 1921). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Black Spot No. 2

description: A rectangular band of black extends forward from a narrow, white and gray shape. These forms run diagonally across the composition. To the right of these, a rounded light blue form is partially visible. Pale yellow shapes fill the bottom of the composition, while dark blue forms spread across the upper right side of the canvas. Just above the black band, a tiny sliver of pink is visible.
title: Black Spot, No. 2
